summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on October 15, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing a corporate rebrand to Aetherion Technologies Inc., effective the same date. No securities, stakes, prices, premiums, advisors, or board recommendations are disclosed. The filing states the new name reflects sharpened focus on commercially ready heavy-duty clean transport technologies, including a majority interest in the Cespira HPDI joint venture with Volvo Group and wholly owned CNG storage and control assets. Shares continue trading under TSX/Nasdaq ticker WPRT. This is a routine corporate identity change, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
